name: M2 Agents workspace
description: The Agents workspace (M2.1/M2.2, ADR-0058) in the real window, driven only by real state. SETUP: two scripted agent sessions reach the app through its harness endpoint, exactly as eak-mcp would: a planner and a layout agent register on the project's WEFT bus, the planner delegates 'Input decoupling' and then 'Route the rails' (which depends on it), the layout agent sets the first task in progress, proposes a capacitor and asks the engineer to review it. The rail's Agents item opens the Agents workspace, not Model settings: the roster lists both agents and both tasks from the journal; Needs you lists the review request; the task graph shows that 'Route the rails' waits on the first task; the inspector shows the task contract with its revision and lists the contract fields WEFT does not record yet; the CI runner has no Claude Code or Codex, so the runtimes read 'Not found' and Launch session is disabled with the reason; no session was started from EAK. Request changes then answers on the WEFT bus and discards the proposal, and the review request leaves Needs you. Covered also by src/agents/agentsModel.test.ts, src/agents/agentsWorkspace.test.tsx, src-tauri/tests/agents.rs and crates/eak-agents (durable sessions).
